hooks.command: AGENTSTOZ_PROJECT_MEMORY_ACTIVITY=codex; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; main="$(git -C "$root" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^worktree //p' | head -n 1)"; if [ -n "$main" ] && [ -f "$main/.agent-memory/config.json" ]; then root="$main"; fi; hook="$root/.agent-memory/activity-hook.sh"; if [ -f "$hook" ]; then /bin/sh "$hook" codex; else cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || :; fi
